output.reason: The linked PR [ev-8b0e88f56478] says what the one-line note [ev-c70532147f60] leaves out. It undoes a field rename that an earlier commit made in the RunFunction protobufs, so the field is called `extra_resources` again. It gives the reason: the rename had an "unexpected impact on the function ecosystem" because many functions expect `extra_resources`. The changed-files list [ev-fa1dfa6980ef] shows that proto/fn/v1 and proto/fn/v1beta1 run_function.proto are affected, which pins down the subject. So the subject is the `extra_resources` field in the RunFunction protobufs. The change is that the original name comes back, so functions expecting it are compatible again; follow-up changes in the function SDKs are still to come [ev-8281b5c31d5c]. Confidence is low because the excerpts never give the interim name or say whether the rename was ever released, so the net before/after compared with the previous release is only implied.
